import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int maxn = 6010;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static int n, m, k, c, d, cnt, ans;
    static int[] a = new int[maxn], x = new int[maxn], y = new int[maxn];
    static int[] head = new int[maxn], pre = new int[maxn], dist = new int[maxn], inq = new int[maxn];
    static Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
    static class Edge {
        int to, cap, cost, nxt;
        Edge(int to, int cap, int cost, int nxt) {
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.nxt = nxt;
        }
    }
    static Edge[] e = new Edge[2000010];

    static int id(int t, int v) {
        return t * n + v;
    }

    static void add(int from, int to, int cap, int cost) {
        e[cnt] = new Edge(to, cap, cost, head[from]);
        head[from] = cnt++;
        e[cnt] = new Edge(from, 0, -cost, head[to]);
        head[to] = cnt++;
    }

    static boolean spfa(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        Arrays.fill(inq, 0);
        q.clear();
        dist[s] = 0;
        q.offer(s);
        inq[s] = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            inq[v] = 0;
            for (int i = head[v]; i != -1; i = e[i].nxt) {
                int u = e[i].to;
                if (e[i].cap > 0 && dist[u] > dist[v] + e[i].cost) {
                    dist[u] = dist[v] + e[i].cost;
                    pre[u] = i;
                    if (inq[u] == 0) {
                        q.offer(u);
                        inq[u] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[t] < 1e9;
    }

    static void upd(int s, int t) {
        for (int i = t; i != s; i = e[pre[i] ^ 1].to) {
            e[pre[i]].cap--;
            e[pre[i] ^ 1].cap++;
        }
        ans += dist[t];
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        d = sc.nextInt();

        int S = 0;
        int T = 6000;

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextInt();
            add(S, id(0, a[i]), 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            x[i] = sc.nextInt();
            y[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }

        for (int t = 0; t <= 100; t++) {
            for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
                add(id(t, i), id(t + 1, i), k, c);
            }
            add(id(t, 1), T, k, 0);
            for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= Math.min(k, 25); j++) {
                    add(id(t, x[i]), id(t + 1, y[i]), 1, c + (2 * j - 1) * d);
                    add(id(t, y[i]), id(t + 1, x[i]), 1, c + (2 * j - 1) * d);
                }
            }
        }

        while (spfa(S, T)) {
            upd(S, T);
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
